前提・単位・境界 γ=5/3、[-.5,.5]²周期、ρ=25/(36π)、p=5/(12π)、vx=sin2πy、vy=−sin2πx、Az=(cos4πx−2cos2πy)/(4π√(4π))、16/32/64²セル。原著の非圧縮・粘性抵抗モデルの再現ではありません。 編集上の補足 少数の固定入力に対する教育用検証です。HLLDのHLLE代替と再構成の正値性スケーリングを数え、セル状態の床・クリップ・再試行は行いません。有限格子参照は厳密解ではなく、任意問題の安定性・正値性や普遍的次数を保証しません。独立比較は終端のみ。中間Athena時刻は指定四半時刻直後で、正確に整列した場とは表示しません。Athenaの固有面発散は出力しておらず測定を主張しません。密度比は圧縮の診断であり数学的衝撃波の証明ではありません。 Late Orszag-Tang: independent reference and compression structure Evolve compressible ideal-MHD Orszag-Tang to T.2 and check density/pressure in interacting compression/shock structure against an independent finite-grid reference. Assumptions, units and boundaries gamma5/3,periodic[-.5,.5]²,rho25/(36pi),p5/(12pi),vx=sin2piy,vy=-sin2pix,Az=(cos4pix-2cos2piy)/(4pi sqrt4pi),16/32/64² cells. This does not reproduce the original incompressible viscous/resistive model. Editorial clarification Educational fixed inputs only. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallbacks and face reconstruction positivity scaling; no cell floor/clipping/retry. Finite-grid references are not exact solutions; no universal stability, positivity or order guarantee. Independent comparisons are final-only. Intermediate Athena outputs occur just after requested quarter times and are not matched frames. Athena native-face divergence is not exported/measured. Density contrast diagnoses compression, not a mathematical proof of shock formation. Adopted numerical method Full-eight-state HLLD fluxes, MC-MUSCL reconstruction and fixed-step Heun. Shared face fluxes and CT-contact corner EMFs update native face B; cell B is adjacent-face averaged.
